parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM deals 
WHERE status IN ('negotiation', 'pending_conflict')
ORDER BY created_at DESC 
LIMIT 20

nodes.name: Query Deals for Dashboard
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL: Gets active deals for dashboard display

parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM bookings 
WHERE booking_status = 'confirmed'
  AND check_out_date >= CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY check_in_date ASC 
LIMIT 20

nodes.name: Query Bookings for Dashboard
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL: Gets confirmed bookings that haven't checked out yet

parameters.query:
SELECT deal_id, client_name, property_name, status, created_at 
FROM deals 
WHERE status IN ('negotiation', 'pending_conflict')
ORDER BY created_at DESC

nodes.name: Query Deals List
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL: Lists all active deals with key fields only

parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM manual_tasks 
WHERE status = 'pending'
ORDER BY priority ASC, due_date ASC 
LIMIT 30

nodes.name: Query Manual Tasks
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL: Gets pending manual tasks, ordered by priority and due date

parameters.query:
SELECT * FROM bookings 
WHERE booking_status = 'confirmed'
  AND check_in_date BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE AND CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days'
ORDER BY check_in_date ASC

nodes.name: Query Upcoming Bookings
nodes.notes: PostgreSQL: Gets bookings checking in within next 7 days

// Professional Help Message with all commands
const commandData = $('Route by Command').first().json;

const helpMessage = `🤖 *PROPERTY OWNER CONTROL PANEL*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

*Available Commands:*

📊 */dashboard*
View your control panel with key metrics and pending items

💼 */deals*
List all active deals requiring your decision

✅ */tasks*
Show all pending manual tasks that need attention

📅 */bookings*
Display upcoming bookings for the next 30 days

🔍 */availability*
Check property availability for specific dates
*Usage:* \`/availability PropertyName YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD\`
*Example:* \`/availability Villa2024 2025-03-15 2025-03-20\`

❓ */help*
Show this help message

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
💡 *Quick Tips:*
• Use inline buttons for easy navigation
• All commands start with /
• Commands are case-insensitive

📞 Need assistance? Contact support.`;

const keyboard = {
  inline_keyboard: [
    [{text: '🏡 Go to Dashboard', callback_data: 'dashboard'}]
  ]
};

return [{
  json: {
    message: helpMessage,
    keyboard: keyboard,
    channel_type: commandData.channel_type,
    sender_id: commandData.sender_id,
    sender_phone: commandData.sender_phone,
    chat_id: commandData.chat_id,
    parse_mode: 'Markdown'
  }
}];
